name: Angela

abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Aptitude: Fury, Armor Up ve Precision etkilerinin gücünü artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.

signatureAbility:
Battle Focus
For each Buff on Angela, her opponent suffers the following:
-[10 - 35]% Nullify & Auto-Block Ability Accuracy.
-[10 - 35]% Damaging Debuff Duration.
immunityDetails:
• TÜM olumsuz etkilerin süresini %100 azaltır ⏰
• %35 Silme (Nullify) direnci (her buff için) 🔮

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: Advanced training allows Angela to Parry Non-Contact attacks.

abilitySections.title: When Damaged
content: For Each 10% Max Health Taken in damage, gain an indefinite Resilience Charge.
When below Max Health, if Angela does not have a Regeneration Buff, she converts 1 Resilience Charge into a Regeneration Buff, healing [6,011.4] Health over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Indefinite Huntress Buff - Always Active
content: Angela gains an indefinite Buff based on her current Power Level.
Below 1 Bar: Armor up, granting +[1,178.57] Armor Rating.
Between 1 and 2 Bars: Fury, granting +[8,809.4] Attack Rating.
Between 2 and 3 Bars: Precision, granting +[2,750] Critical Rating.
3 Bars: Aptitude, increasing the Potency of all Fury, Armor Up and Precision Buffs by 60%.

abilitySections.title: Temporary Huntress Buffs - Critical Hits
content: 100% chance to duplicate the current, indefinite Huntress Buff. This duplicated Buff lasts 15 seconds. A maximum of 1 of each type of Huntress Buff may be duplicated at a time.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: This attack receives [2,750] additional Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Angela's terrifying aura inflicts 1 Armor Break Debuff on the opponent for each Buff on Angela, removing an Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by +[305.56] for 7 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to gain a Fury Buff for 5 seconds, granting +[8,809.4] Attack.
This Fury Buff instead lasts 20 seconds if Angela already had a Fury Buff active on herself.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to gain an Armor Up Buff for 5 seconds, granting +[1,178.57] Armor Rating.
This Armor Up Buff instead lasts 20 seconds if Angela already had an Armor Up Buff active on herself.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% Chance to grant an Aptitude Buff, increasing the potency of Armor, Fury, and Precision Buffs by 60% lasting for 5 seconds.
This Aptitude Buff instead lasts 30 seconds if Angela already had a Aptitude Buff active on herself.
Angela's Attack Rating is increased by +[5,182] for each Buff active on her during the attack.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Battle Focus
content: For each Buff on Angela, her opponent suffers the following:
-[10 - 35]% Nullify & Auto-Block Ability Accuracy.
-[10 - 35]% Damaging Debuff Duration.
